name: William G. Hagans
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas
side_practice_areas: Business Litigation, Personal Injury, Professional Liability
education: The University of Texas School of Law
about: William did not inherit a courtroom reputation. He has spent his career building one.

His practice is deliberately broad. Recent matters have involved breach of contract, catastrophic trucking negligence, insurance coverage, oilfield negligence, professional negligence, non-compete agreements, and trade secret and copyright disputes. He is comfortable in a commercial arbitration and comfortable in front of a Harris County jury, and he believes the second is what makes a lawyer useful in the first.

William is board certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Thomson Reuters has named him a Texas Super Lawyer every year since 2014 and a Top 100 Houston Super Lawyer for the last two years. In 2026 he was elected to the American Board of Trial Advocates, a national invitation-only organization of experienced trial lawyers and judges; an honor extended by peers and by the judges who have watched them work.

He has given the same energy to the profession itself. William is a past chair of the State Bar of Texas Professionalism Committee, co-chairs the Houston Bar Association’s Civil and Appellate Bench Bar Conference committee, and is the past Fellows Chair of the Texas Bar Foundation. He is also the past board chair of the Houston chapter of Breakthrough T1D, formerly JDRF.

William’s Texas roots run deep. He was born and raised in Houston. He and his wife, Jance, were married in the same Austin church where his parents, his grandparents, and his aunt and uncle were married. Their son, William Jr. (Liam) was in Rockets and Longhorns gear before he could walk.
